subject: Invite delivery & device-bound MFA blocking for Sunrise vendor setup
messages:
From: Claire Huang <claire.huang@sunrisecomponents.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: procure-support@sunrisecomponents.com
Date: Tue, 14 May 2029 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sunrise onboarding invite - can't accept (MFA device bind)

Hi Alex,

Thanks for sending the invite. I tried to accept the supplier portal invite this morning but the flow fails when it tries to bind my security key / authenticator app. The UI shows an error: "Device binding timeout - TIMESTAMP_MISMATCH" and then redirects me back to the login screen. See attached screenshot.

We are on UTC+8 in our APAC office and the developer tools show the SSO redirect goes to your login node in us-west, then back to coupa with a 302. I can still log into our corporate IdP, but the portal never completes the final step.

Can your team provide a fallback activation link or a way to bypass the device-bound binding so we can finish vendor setup? We have a PO pending (PO #SC-5021) that needs the supplier bank info live by Friday.

Thanks,
Claire Huang
Procurement Manager
Sunrise Component Co.
attachments: invite-screenshot.png (png, 420KB)
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Claire Huang <claire.huang@sunrisecomponents.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2029 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sunrise onboarding invite - can't accept (MFA device bind)

Hi Claire — sorry for the friction and thanks for the clear repro.

Quick plan:
- Ben (our onboarding support) will try a one-time activation fallback link and check whether device binding is being enforced at the SSO layer.
- Marissa will standby to manually complete the vendor account (bank details) if the link fails, so your PO isn't blocked.

Ben, can you generate a one-time activation URL scoped to Claire's email and send instructions (include the link as a plain .txt file to avoid client rewriting)? Also please record the SSO redirect logs to the Drive link above for later postmortem.

Claire — I set the related HubSpot record to high priority and added the PO tag so our SLA targets this. We'll aim to have either the portal active or bank details posted to your PO by EOD Friday.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Claire Huang <claire.huang@sunrisecomponents.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2029 10:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sunrise onboarding invite - can't accept (MFA device bind)

Hey all — taking this one.

Troubleshooting notes (what I checked):
- Confirmed the invite token generated at 2029-05-14T15:40:12Z for claire.huang@sunrisecomponents.com is valid and not expired.
- Observed the SAML Assertion Consumer redirect includes a timestamp that is ~6 minutes in the future relative to our validation node (TIMESTAMP_MISMATCH). This can happen when device-bound MFA performs an extra roundtrip and the relayState ttl is shorter than the roundtrip latency across regions.

Workaround: created a one-time activation URL that skips device binding and forces manual validation. Link is in the attached plain text file (one-time-activation-link.txt). Claire, please try the link in an incognito window and use your corporate IdP when prompted. If that works I'll mark the vendor as verified and then we can complete bank details.

If the fallback fails I can also complete the vendor record manually using the bank-details-template.csv (attached) and mark the account as "onboarded by ops" so your PO can route. Note: manual onboarding will require Sunrise to e-sign vendor attestation (I can trigger DocuSign).

I'll also raise a ticket for the SSO relay TTL mismatch with the infra team so we can increase the acceptance window for the affected login node.

Attachments: one-time-activation-link.txt, bank-details-template.csv

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Onboarding Support Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Claire Huang <claire.huang@sunrisecomponents.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 May 2029 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sunrise onboarding invite - can't accept (MFA device bind)

Ben — the one-time link worked when I opened it in an incognito window and authenticated via our IdP. I was able to finish the supplier profile and upload our bank verification (IBAN + SWIFT).

A couple of follow-ups:
- Can you confirm which PO field names map to our internal finance system? We saw fields labeled "Payee name" and "Routing identifier" and want to ensure no mapping surprises when the invoice hits AP.
- We received the e-sign request for attestation. We'll sign it today.

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Please keep me posted on the SSO relay TTL fix so this doesn't recur for other Sunrise users in different timezones.

Regards,
Claire Huang
Procurement Manager
Sunrise Component Co.
